versions.content: On invocation of EthTSyn_RxIndication() or in the following EthTSyn _MainFunction() call, a reference time shall be retrieved on reception of the Follow_Up message via EthIf_GetCurrentTime () f rom the EthIf and con verted to the Virtual Local Time T2 VLT , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to TRUE and if the StbM does use the Ethernet hardware counter as Virtual Local Time Source for the Time Base. The Sync reception delay shall be calculated as T2 VLT – T1 VLT .

The Sync reception delay shall be calculated as T2 VLT – T1 VLT .
